Dwarfcraft Devices browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Dwarfcraft Devices The Internet Published on September 8, 2010 Dwarfcraft Devices overdrive pedal preview preview preview preview Information Dwarfcraft Devices Dwarfcraft has reinvented The Internet, and this time it's analog! The Internet is a good old-fashioned overdrive pedal, with a footswitchable gain boost that goes from comfy crunch to completely nuts! Gain and volume controls make it simple to find the distorted tone you're after. Priced low to enable Internet access to everyone! Runs on an industry-standard 9V, center-negative power adapter.
